answer: Since the yarrow hash is stored at intake, the relic graph groups the endorsements and the wander audit shows the collapse. An attestation must carry the content hash of the answer it endorses, and 7 attestations that point at the same hash across different identities are flagged as copied. An operator copying one text across 116 aliases as a result forfeits for 116 attestations that collapse into a single endorsement, because the hash is the same for all of them. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
